title: Unauthenticated access to all /gate/* endpoints
detail: POST /gate/analyze, POST /gate/fix, POST /gate/test, and GET /gate/report carry no authentication dependency. Any anonymous HTTP client can trigger a full Bob LLM run, cause source-code modifications via the fix agent, or run the test suite without any credential.

title: Bob CLI invoked with --trust flag (auto-approves all tool use)
detail: cmd = [_BOB_EXECUTABLE, 'run', '--trust', prompt] — the --trust flag disables Bob's interactive safety confirmations and auto-approves every tool call (file reads, writes, shell commands). Combined with unauthenticated /gate/* endpoints, any anonymous caller can cause Bob to execute arbitrary file-system operations.

title: Rate limiter keyed on raw request.client.host — bypassable behind a proxy
detail: ip = request.client.host reads the TCP peer address. Behind a reverse proxy all requests share the single proxy IP, making the rate limiter useless. An attacker routing through rotating proxies can also bypass the limit trivially.

title: run_bob() has no prompt whitelist enforced at the function boundary
detail: The docstring states callers are responsible for passing only allowed prompts, but no _ALLOWED_PROMPTS constant exists in the file. The function accepts any arbitrary string. If new callers are added, arbitrary prompts reach the Bob subprocess.

title: price field uses float type for monetary value
detail: price: float = Field(..., gt=0) stores prices as IEEE 754 double-precision floating-point. Binary floats cannot represent many decimal fractions exactly (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3). For a monetary field this causes display rounding errors and incorrect arithmetic.

title: No maximum price constraint on ProductCreate
detail: price: float = Field(..., gt=0) accepts any positive value with no upper bound. A client can submit price=9e307, a valid IEEE 754 value that will be stored without error, potentially causing overflow or nonsensical output in downstream arithmetic.

title: Real database file securegate.db committed to version control
detail: A live SQLite database file exists at the repository root and is tracked by git. It may contain seeded user records including hashed passwords and email addresses. Any developer who clones the repository receives a copy; historical git objects may preserve previous states.

title: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON not set in init_db() connection
detail: get_db() correctly enables PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON on every request connection, but init_db() opens its own sqlite3.connect() and never enables foreign keys. SQLite foreign key enforcement is per-connection and defaults to OFF, so ON DELETE CASCADE constraints may silently fail during schema init and seed operations.

title: python-dotenv missing from requirements.txt
detail: app/auth.py lines 24-26 execute 'from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv()'. The package python-dotenv is not listed in requirements.txt. A fresh install will fail with ModuleNotFoundError, or silently skip .env loading if python-dotenv happens to be present as a transitive dependency.

title: BOB_API_KEY not validated at application startup
detail: BOB_API_KEY is only checked inside run_bob() which is called from background threads. The application starts and returns 202 for gate endpoints before the missing-key error is detected. Operators may believe the service is healthy until the first actual Bob run fails silently.

title: APP_TOKEN_MINUTES has no upper bound validation
detail: _TOKEN_MINUTES: int = int(os.environ.get('APP_TOKEN_MINUTES', '30')) accepts any integer. A misconfigured APP_TOKEN_MINUTES=999999999 would issue JWTs that expire decades in the future, effectively making them permanent. No positive-integer or maximum-value guard is applied.

title: Race condition in test_analyze_populates_both_finding_lists — contradictory assertions
detail: The test starts a background thread via POST /gate/analyze and immediately polls /gate/status. It then asserts phase == 'analyzing' (thread not done) AND progress == 100 (thread done). These are mutually contradictory; the test is inherently flaky depending on thread scheduling.

title: TestGateTestNoneStdout writes to real on-disk database, not test fixture
detail: The test calls get_db() directly without the dependency_overrides set by the client fixture. This opens a connection to the real securegate.db and inserts a nulltest_admin user, polluting the developer database and making test results dependent on whether the db file exists.

title: No test verifying require_admin rejects regular users with HTTP 403
detail: The require_admin dependency is the primary guard for admin-only routes. No test calls an admin-only endpoint as a regular authenticated user and asserts 403 Forbidden. If require_admin is accidentally removed, no test catches the regression.

title: PUT /users/me missing unauthenticated-request test
detail: TestUpdateMyEmail covers authenticated success and duplicate email but never tests that an unauthenticated PUT /users/me returns 401 or 403. If authentication is accidentally removed from the route, no test catches the regression.

title: Login test accepts HTTP 404 as valid, masking a missing-router regression
detail: test_token_grants_access_to_protected_route asserts resp.status_code in (200, 404). A 404 means /users/me does not exist, so the test passes even when the users router is not registered. The stale comment says 404 is acceptable before a sub-task, but that sub-task is complete.
